description: Opens a timeline's TAB in the editor (the user can close tabs to keep the tab row short; a closed timeline is not deleted and every tool works on it as before). By default it does not change what the user is looking at; activate:true also shows it, like set_active_timeline. get_timeline reports `open` per timeline, as last saved.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: open_timeline
title: Open timeline tab
